data.name: Nedda
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Nedda was an epithet for the goddess Demeter. The name means 'comforter' or 'solace', reflecting Demeter's role as a nurturing and protective deity. In Christianity, Nedda can be seen as a symbol of consolation and hope.
